messages:
maya: Quick request — can someone run an onboarding smoke + profiling bench for pegasus-6b-vx? Need p50/p95 for 256 tokens, batch sizes 1/4/8, and both fp16 + 4-bit quant (q4_0). Include KV cache mem growth, CUDA/util logs, and a short cost estimate. Target p50 < 60ms if possible. cc @jamie @sandeep

jamie: Ack, I can kick off a smoke run today. Do we have a canonical eval prompt set to use? Also confirm we want continuous batching on for the batch=8 runs.

alex: Use `short-dialogs-v2` for the prompts (link: https://internal/assets/evals/short-dialogs-v2). And yes, run both with continuous batching enabled and disabled so we can compare.

maya: Perfect. Also include startup/kickoff latency (first token) and a cold-start run if you can.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-pegasus6bvx-1769009876-smoke. Params: seq=256, batches=[1,4,8], modes=[fp16,q4_0], cont_batch=[on,off]. ETA ~12m.

infra-bot: Node allocated: rtx-a5000-1 (1x A5000) for bench-pegasus6bvx-1769009876-smoke. Docker image: redwood/bench:2026-03. Logs streaming to /var/log/benches/1769009876.log

sandeep: Posting initial smoke results (fp16): p50=72ms, p95=198ms, tail(99)=410ms, tokens/sec(batch=8)=240. KV cache memory: baseline 1.0GB, after 50 tokens ~1.1GB. CUDA util ~92% steady, occasional spikes to 98%.

sandeep: fp16 batch=1 => p50=140ms, batch=4 => p50=95ms, batch=8 => p50=72ms. q4_0: batch=8 => p50=88ms, p95=270ms, tail=540ms. Observed larger tail and GC pauses on q4_0 when cache grows.

maya: Thanks — that's helpful. Two follow-ups: 1) Can you run q4_0 with eager KV eviction (keep_last_n=48) and 2) a run with continuous batching disabled for batch=8, to see the latency delta?

jamie: I'll schedule both. Also I'll pull the CUDA traces and a quick nvprof flame to share.

sandeep: Started q4_0+evict job. Early note: evict reduce tail by ~15% in a quick sample. Will publish full numbers when done.

jamie: Attached quick nvprof excerpt: `gpu_kernel_time: attention_forward 48%, gelu_fwd 12%, matmul 30%` — attention kernel is the main hotspot.

alex: Noted — from model side we can try an attention kernel tweak (tiling) in the runtime, but that needs a small microkernel change. If the numbers stay, I can open a PR for a tiled attention path.

maya: Action items: sandeep -> finish q4_0+evict and cont-batch-off runs and post full table; jamie -> upload CUDA traces and add perf dashboard links; alex -> prototype tiled-attention PR if hotspot confirmed. We'll re-evaluate after Sandeep's final numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:

bench-bot: Job complete: bench-pegasus6bvx-1769009876-q4_0-evict. Summary posted to /var/log/benches/1769009876-q4_0-evict.json

sandeep: Final summarized numbers (attached): fp16 batch=8 cont_on p50=72ms p95=198ms cost est=0.023$/k token; q4_0 batch=8 cont_on p50=88ms p95=270ms cost est=0.014$/k token; q4_0+evict batch=8 cont_on p50=75ms p95=230ms. Continuous batching off increases p50 ~+18ms across modes.

maya: Excellent — that's enough to make a decision for the model card. Alex, can you start the model card PR with the fp16 baseline and q4_0 caveats?

alex: Yep, will open a draft PR with the numbers and runtime notes.

jamie: I'll link the perf dashboard here once I extract the traces.

maya: Closing loop — we'll mark pegasus-6b-vx as "onboard-candidate" pending the tiled-attention prototyping. Thanks everyone.
